financing.summary: National Home Corp. is a private, founder-owned entry-level builder (550 closings in 2025, pacing 800+ in 2026) that buys finished lots only, builds 100% spec and describes its land exposure as limited; it does not develop land and publishes no lot count. A conventional for-sale builder that also sells to and fee-builds for build-to-rent investors, it is a plausible but small land-banking customer: its stated plan to reach about 1,200 homes under construction by year-end 2026 and 1,500 to 1,800 closings in 2027 implies a much larger finished-lot pipeline than it has needed so far, and its site openly solicits developed homesites from sellers. No land banker, lot-option financier, equity sponsor or credit facility is publicly named; the only lender names on record are from 2022 (Wells Fargo, 'Regents' as printed, Fifth Third and Flagstar funding start-up operations). The one disclosed joint venture is NHC Mortgage with loanDepot, a buyer-mortgage venture, not land capital. No public link to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found.
financing.land_strategy: Land-light by design: buys finished lots from developers, builds standardized plans 100% spec, and aims to keep capital exposed for as short a time as possible (the Wade Jurney Homes playbook: just-in-time lot takedowns, fast inventory turns, pace over margin). No stated owned/optioned target. The company site runs a 'We Buy Lots' / 'Sell Land' page asking owners of developed homesites and build-for-rent partners to submit deals.

lots.source_title: HousingWire / The Builder's Daily: National Home Corp. targets 18% gross margin with pace focus
lots.note: No lot count is public. Only inventory indicators: about 1,200 homes targeted to be under construction by year-end 2026, 93 starts and 70 closings in July 2026. A third-party deed-record aggregator (SFR Analytics) shows the entity taking title to lots and homes in North Carolina through July 2026 with little recorded mortgage data, which fits lot-by-lot finished-lot takedowns but is not a lot count.

capital_events.description: At the one-year mark HousingWire reported that four lenders, printed as Wells Fargo, Regents, Fifth Third and Flagstar, had provided capital financing to fund start-up operations across 11 states and 26 markets. No facility sizes, structures or maturities were given.
capital_events.source_title: HousingWire / The Builder's Daily: Jurney Mapping: Wade Jurney's Pursuit Of Affordability Continues
capital_events.note: Stale (2022) and not reconfirmed, so tagged Inferred; current lender group is not public. 'Regents' is as printed in the article and probably means Regions Bank (unconfirmed).

joint_ventures.description: NHC Mortgage, a joint-venture mortgage company serving National HomeCorp buyers, launched in Florida, Iowa and North Carolina with more states planned for 2023. This is a buyer-financing venture, not land or construction capital. The company's financing page still discloses an ownership interest in NHC Mortgage as a joint venture.
joint_ventures.source_title: loanDepot press release: loanDepot and National HomeCorp launch NHC Mortgage
joint_ventures.note: Current ownership disclosure seen on nationalhomecorp.com/financing (retrieved 2026-11-19); that page does not name loanDepot, so the partner today is confirmed only as of the 2022 release.

gaps: Lot counts (owned / optioned / controlled): not publicly disclosed (private company)
Land banker, lot-option financier or developer partners: none publicly named
Credit facilities, lender group, facility sizes and maturities: not publicly disclosed; the only lender names are from a 2022 article and may be out of date
Equity ownership and any outside capital partner: not publicly disclosed; company presents as founder-owned (Jurney, Bergman, Erickson)
Debt, cash, liquidity, leverage: not publicly disclosed; the company says its financials are audited but does not publish them. Only operating datapoint: about 18% gross margin in July 2026
Build-to-rent / fee-build share of closings and named BTR investor clients: not publicly disclosed
M&A 2025 to date: none found (no acquisitions, no sale); background only: founder Wade Jurney sold Wade Jurney Homes to Century Communities in 2016 to 2018
No public link to Domain Real Estate Partners, Millrose Properties, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon found
